name: feature
title: Feature development
description: Take a feature from a written spec through planning, implementation, verification and review to a merged pull request.

mainBranch.description: Default branch that feature branches start from and pull requests target

specsDir.description: Directory (relative to the project root) where feature specs are written

testCommand.description: Command that runs the full test suite

featureBranchPrefix.description: Prefix for your feature branch names

reviewer.description: GitHub handle (without the leading @) to request pull request reviews from; leave empty to choose per pull request

spec-feature.description: Write a feature spec with goals, scope and testable acceptance criteria. Use when starting a new feature or when a feature request is still vague.

plan-feature.description: Turn an approved feature spec into an ordered implementation plan of small, tested increments. Use after the spec is agreed and before writing code.

BACK.description: The spec is missing information needed to plan

implement-feature.description: Implement the planned feature increment by increment with tests on the feature branch. Use when a plan exists or when verification or review sent work back.

BACK.description: The plan turned out to be wrong and must be revised

verify-feature.description: Verify the implemented feature against every acceptance criterion and run the full test suite. Use when the implementation is believed to be complete.

review-feature.description: Review the feature branch diff like a strict code reviewer before it ships. Use after verification passes and before opening a pull request.

CHANGES_REQUESTED.description: The review found issues that need code changes

ship-feature.description: Ship the reviewed feature by pushing the branch, opening the pull request and seeing it through CI and merge. Use when the review is approved.

CHANGES_REQUESTED.description: Pull request reviewers or CI require code changes
